caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden spoon, centrally positioned and oriented diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. The spoon is rendered in shades of brown with the bowl section darker and smoothly shaded to indicate depth, while the handle has lighter brown hues and visible wood grain patterns. The spoon’s handle is gently curved and has a slightly squared-off end. There are a few small brown spots and specks scattered around the spoon on the light beige background, which is otherwise plain and untextured. In the lower right corner, the name "Wilbur M. Rice" is written in small, neat letters.
